briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Grok-4 push multi-agent frontiers amid escalating race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate releases while compute constraints tighten. Global AI investment remains robust with regulatory scrutiny increasing in US and EU.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with advanced reasoning; xAI releases Grok-4 for real-time inference; DeepSeek-V3 and Meta Llama 4 variants expand open ecosystem.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and BCI use cases.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp accelerates; Google and Microsoft announce new 100k GPU clusters; TSMC reports record AI chip orders for Q3.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent coordination breakthroughs outpace current safety frameworks by end of 2026?
